designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1996 under the Arizona-Florida Land Exchange Act of 1988, which set aside exchanged Florida lands for a new refuge.

authority.citation: Arizona-Florida Land Exchange Act of 1988, Public Law 100-696

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Ten Thousand Islands National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
CRE Federal Law: Arizona-Florida Land Exchange Act (P.L. 100-696) directed 19,620 acres of Florida land "be used to establish a new Ten Thousand Islands National Wildlife Refuge"
Bonefish & Tarpon Trust (2023): the Arizona-Florida land swap created Ten Thousand Islands National Wildlife Refuge

review.note: Authority confirmed. The 1996 date rests on FWS; the act passed in 1988, so no signer is set.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Ten Thousand Islands National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1996 under provisions of the Arizona-Florida Land Exchange Act of 1988.
